subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
In mitosis, one cell divides into
A) two cells with the same DNA
B) two cells with different DNA
C) a protein
D) no cells
items.answer: A) two cells with the same DNA

items.prompt:
Mitosis lets an organism
A) grow and repair
B) stop growing
C) lose its DNA
D) shrink only

steps: New cells allow growth and repair.

items.prompt:
When cells become specialized into different types, this is
A) mitosis
B) differentiation
C) homeostasis
D) respiration

How does mitosis help a cut heal?
A) It makes new cells to replace damaged ones
B) It removes all cells
C) It changes the DNA
D) It stops healing
items.answer: A) It makes new cells to replace damaged ones

steps: New cells from mitosis repair the wound.

items.prompt:
Two cells from mitosis have the same DNA but become a muscle cell and a skin cell because of
A) differentiation
B) a mutation in each
C) different DNA
D) respiration

Both mitosis and differentiation are needed because
A) mitosis makes cells and differentiation gives them specialized jobs
B) they are the same thing
C) neither is needed
D) differentiation makes DNA
items.answer: A) mitosis makes cells and differentiation gives them specialized jobs

steps: Both build a complex organism together.

items.prompt:
A single fertilized egg becomes a whole organism because it
A) divides by mitosis into many cells that differentiate into specialized types
B) stays one cell
C) only makes skin
D) never divides
items.answer: A) divides by mitosis into many cells that differentiate into specialized types

steps: Mitosis plus differentiation builds the organism.

items.prompt:
Without differentiation, lots of mitosis would produce
A) all the same kind of cell, with no specialized types
B) a complete organism
C) only nerve cells
D) proteins
items.answer: A) all the same kind of cell, with no specialized types

steps: Without differentiation there are no specialized cells.
